name: vliw-bundling-kernel-optimization
description: VLIW instruction bundling and batch-SIMD vectorization authoring workflow for a repository-local CPU Python VLIW simulator (integration_pattern custom_simulator). An advisory analyst agent reads the one-slot-per-bundle KernelBuilder stream (147734 charged cycles, ~4 percent issue utilization) and returns bundle and vectorization opportunities; an advisory generator agent returns a complete drop-in KernelBuilder that packs independent slots across engines (alu/valu/load/store/flow) into legal multi-slot bundles and vectorizes the batch axis with vload/vstore/valu/vbroadcast (VLEN=8). Returns the candidate source via best_kernel_code with a static cycle estimate; correctness and benchmark measurement stay with the enclosing host verifier.
